recentItems.title: What Does the Government Really Know About UFOs? | The UnXplained (S2, E4) | Full Episode
recentItems.description:
For decades, mysterious UFO sightings have raised questions about what governments really know—and what they may have kept secret. From Roswell and alleged crash-recovery programs to Project Blue Book and eyewitness accounts of unexplained encounters, investigators examine the history of official involvement with the UFO phenomenon.

Then, newly revealed Pentagon investigations and extraordinary encounters involving U.S. military pilots bring the mystery into the modern era. Could some UFOs represent technology beyond our understanding, and how much does the government actually know? The UnXplained (S2, E4) investigates the evidence behind one of history's most enduring mysteries. 

#TheUnXplained
